description: Ingest refusal reporting. Each case replays input.calls (raw is a text body, or {bytes_hex} for bytes, or {none:true}; status; debug) against a fresh warned-codes set and records every log record the SDK emits (level + formatted message). Warn once per code, at most 64 distinct codes.
